entrance.name: Crypt Entrance
entrance.desc: Damp stone walls close in around you. A rusted gate to the north is chained shut.

hall.name: Dark Hall
hall.desc: A long corridor. Torches sputter in iron sconces. Passages lead east and north.

puzzle_room.name: The Whispering Alcove
puzzle_room.desc: A carved stone face stares from the far wall. The passage north is sealed.

treasure_room.name: Ossuary
treasure_room.desc: Shelves of skulls line the walls. A battered chest sits in the centre.

boss_chamber.name: The Throne of Dust
boss_chamber.desc: A vaulted chamber draped in cobwebs. On a throne of bones sits the Wight Lord.

gate_lock.desc: The gate is secured with a heavy padlock.
gate_lock.success_msg: The lock clicks open. The gate swings wide.
gate_lock.fail_msg: You don't have anything to open this with.

crypt_riddle.desc: A carved face on the wall speaks: 'I have cities but no houses. Mountains but no trees. What am I?'
crypt_riddle.success_msg: The carved face smiles. A hidden door grinds open to the north.
crypt_riddle.fail_msg: The face is silent. Nothing happens.
crypt_riddle.hint: Think about what shows places without being a place itself.
